phases.name: The Heads Grow Back
phases.say: Cut one off. I have nine more opinions of you.

say.open: A king of a golden city does not kneel. He is knelt to. Begin.
say.death: Ten heads... and not one of them saw this coming...

bestiary.lore: A demon king with ten heads and twenty arms, who once stole a queen and a flying chariot, and took a golden city from his own brother. He keeps a seventh shrine among the six, and calls it his.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Interrupt the Chariot while it circles; in the second half, break his Regen before it outlasts you.
bestiary.pattern: His ten voices strike everyone every fourth turn, the Chariot charges at the densest row every third, and the moon-pale sword cuts the strongest between. At half he grows a head back (Regen) every fourth turn and cuts the weakest.
